content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A tailored wool-blend trench coat in deep charcoal (#2F2F2F), a classic H-line cut falling to mid-calf with a water-resistant finish. A structured navy blue blazer with a single button front and sharp lapels, sized for a relaxed fit through the shoulders. High-waisted wide-leg trousers in black crepe fabric, cut straight from hip to ankle length to accommodate movement on wet pavement. A silk camisole top in forest green (#1E4D2B), featuring a square neckline and elbow-length sleeves for modesty under rain. Chunky leather ankle boots in oxblood red (#7C1616) with a thick block heel and a grippy rubber sole to handle the storm. A structured tote bag in black pebbled leather with gold hardware, spacious enough for a ticket stub and evening essentials. This outfit works because the trench coat shields her from the rain and wind while maintaining a sophisticated silhouette suitable for both the theater entrance and the subsequent dinner. The color palette of charcoal, navy, and forest green creates a harmonious, moody look appropriate for an evening date under artificial lighting, while the oxblood boots add a touch of boldness that elevates the casual \"everyday\" requirement into something special. The wide-leg trousers allow for comfortable walking on potentially slippery streets without sacrificing elegance, perfectly balancing her need for protection against the cold weather with the desire to look put-together for her evening out."}
